outcome.technical: _manifest_merge.py: MERGE_UNITS (kind, keys, whole|container|map, reason) with ELEMENT_KINDS and REF_KINDS. Whole rows may share a key. `_units(kind, b, o, t, extra)` merges each row whole and joins the rows both sides changed with every row sharing a key that some side moved; an unmoved shared key goes to the conflicting unit. Task rows are split into a start {status,startedAt,attempts,blockedReason} and a close {status,commit,completedAt,outcome,verifiedBy,redFirst}. Finding rows are a disposition {status,commit,resolution,acceptedReason,carriedTo} and a link {fixTask,commit}. Bug row is {status,taskId,fixedIn}; notes were dropped from it, with the cost stated in the suite. render skips a file that holds none of the conflicts, and foreign_values judges by the same units. merge-manifest.py: _foreign_records judges against base/ours/theirs and, after renumbering, the renamed side. It reads every plan file, but passes over a file both sides hold alike once it parses to what they hold; the stray refusal says 'nothing was written' once. Tests: test__manifest_merge.py wv1-wv27 (59/59) and test_merge_manifest.py rr1-rr10 (74/74). The writers scan (wv23/wv24) asks the merge itself: a co-write is held when _units makes it one unit. Reasons sit in _CO_WRITES_APART, which now points at the write's line, with phase status justified with its cost in _PHASE_STATUS. The shapes the scan reads are named once in SCAN_READS and every branch of _co_writes is guarded by its name; wv25 holds one fixture per name both ways, each found with every shape read and lost with its own left out, and wv26 holds two quiet shapes. layout.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and CHANGELOG.md were updated. Gate sweep: 4/4 files ok, 723 cases. Dependants and lints: 6/6 ok, 973 cases. ruff and vermin exited 0. fuzz.py seeds 0,1,2,3,4,11,23,57 at 300: bad 0. Resolve timing (two rounds, 45 s gap). MED2 sequence: HEAD 1.81/1.50 then 1.45/1.42 s; fixed 1.49/1.32 then 1.24/1.17 s. No-collision repro (copy of the reviewer's wrb repo, P162 run recorded while stopped): HEAD 0.65 then 0.60 s; fixed 0.70 then 0.72 s, naming docs/audit/phases/P162.json: tasks[P162.1].{lastRun,testEvidence}.
outcome.descriptive: Each verb's account in the plan merges whole, and two accounts are joined only when they meet on a key that moved. Resolve names a hand-mixed or stopped-merge record in any plan file at about HEAD's cost.
